name: agentcraft
description: Production-grade Claude plugin for building, evaluating, and deploying agents with the LangChain/LangGraph ecosystem — RAG pipelines, multi-agent topologies, MCP tools, LLM evaluation, observability, and Python engineering standards.

mlflow_tracking_uri.title: MLflow Tracking URI
mlflow_tracking_uri.description: MLflow tracking server URI (e.g. http://localhost:5000 or a remote MLflow server). Omit to use the default local file store.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API Key
openai_api_key.description: Optional — required only if using OpenAI or Azure OpenAI models

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API Key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional — required only if using Anthropic models directly (not via Bedrock)
